parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button made of plastic located on the top or side of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position after release.

parts.name: Lid (Tank Cover)
parts.Basic_description: A ceramic lid that covers the water tank of the toilet.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal flushing components and prevents debris from entering the tank.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted off for maintenance but remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Lid (Seat Cover)
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lid that covers the toilet seat when not in use.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a cover for hygiene and aesthetic purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge at the back of the seat.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: A plastic ring-shaped seat attached to the toilet bowl.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable surface for sitting during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around a hinge for cleaning or covering.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main ceramic body of the toilet that includes the bowl and tank structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and contains the water flow system for flushing waste.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structure anchored to the floor.
